claims: Dan Levy's new show is titled Big Mistakes.
Big Mistakes is a dark comedy-crime series.
Big Mistakes premiered on Netflix on April 9, 2026.
Big Mistakes follows two siblings, Nicky and Morgan.
Dan Levy plays Nicky in Big Mistakes.
Taylor Ortega plays Morgan in Big Mistakes.
Nicky and Morgan are blackmailed into the world of organized crime after a botched, misguided theft in Big Mistakes.
Nicky is an uptight pastor in Big Mistakes.
Morgan is Nicky's chaotic teacher sister in Big Mistakes.
Laurie Metcalf plays Linda in Big Mistakes.
Linda is Nicky and Morgan's unhinged, emotionally intense mother in Big Mistakes.
Jack Innanen is in the additional cast of Big Mistakes.
Abby Quinn is in the additional cast of Big Mistakes.
Elizabeth Perkins is in the additional cast of Big Mistakes.
Big Mistakes was co-created by Dan Levy and Rachel Sennott.
Critics describe Big Mistakes as a "hilariously caustic" and "wildly dysfunctional" family saga.
The sibling dynamic in Big Mistakes is loosely inspired by Dan Levy's relationship with his real-life sister, Sarah Levy.
Big Mistakes is currently streaming on Netflix.
